info.title: Super GALS! (ITA)
info.synopsis:
Protagonista della storia è Ran Kotobuki, sedicenne autoproclamatasi «la più grande gal del mondo». Ran è del tutto determinata a vivere la propria intera esistenza seguendo i dettami etici ed estetici delle kogal, ed anche per tale ragione ha ottenuto la reputazione della più rispettata gal di Shibuya, dedicando la sua vita al divertimento. Tuttavia Ran proviene da una famiglia di poliziotti da generazioni, infatti anche i genitori ed il fratello maggiore Yamato sono in polizia, mentre sua sorella minore, già da bambina, sogna di intraprendere la tradizione di famiglia; Ran invece, come si può immaginare, ha altri obiettivi per il proprio futuro, benché abbia ereditato il senso della giustizia dalla famiglia. La serie ruota attorno alla vita quotidiana di Ran e delle sue due amiche Miyu ed Aya; tramite questi due personaggi secondari la serie affronta temi piuttosto delicati come i rapporti familiari, i problemi della crescita, le questioni legate all'adolescenza e fenomeni sociali come l'enjo kōsai.(trama tratta da Wikipedia)
NB: La Rai ha trasmesso solo i primi 26 episodi, gli altri sono inediti e non sono stati doppiati in Italiano. Dynit ha pubblicato anche un cofanetto dvd, ma solo di quei 26 episodi.

info.title: Clevatess
info.synopsis: Alicia, una ragazza che aspira a diventare una coraggiosa eroina fin dalla sua infanzia, viene scelta dal re del suo regno come uno dei tredici eroi per una rischiosa missione. Brandendo spade magiche, dovranno soggiogare Clevatess, il signore delle bestie magiche, che possiede un intelletto superiore e un potere distruttivo immenso. Tuttavia la presenza degli eroi inizia a infastidire Clevatess, che decide di sbarazzarsi dell'umanita una volta per tutte, se non ci fosse un "piccolo problema" che lo tiene a freno: il ritrovamento di un neonato umano. Deciso ad accudirlo, ora questo piccolo umano è diventato l'unica speranza di salvezza per questo mondo.

episodes.title: The Lord of Dark Beasts

episodes.title: Hero`s Duty
episodes.synopsis: Nell is punished for her dreams of freedom.

episodes.title: Magical Talent
episodes.synopsis: Clevatess and Alicia's time at the bandit camp nears its end.

episodes.title: Boelate`s March
episodes.synopsis: Clevatess and Alicia are suddenly attacked by an unexpected opponent.

episodes.title: Insect Controlling Wizard
episodes.synopsis: Alicia and Nelluru stop at a small village after destroying the bandits.

episodes.title: Secrets of Magic
episodes.synopsis: Drel's wizards come to steal Luna away.

episodes.title: Current of Insects
episodes.synopsis: Alicia continues her battle against the wizards.

episodes.title: War Zone Hiderat
episodes.synopsis: The battle intensifies as Drel's army reaches Hiderat.

episodes.title: Margo and Drel
episodes.synopsis: The truth about Drel's origins is revealed.

episodes.title: Fake Hero
episodes.synopsis: The truth about the hero legend is revealed.

episodes.title: Return of the King
episodes.synopsis: Alicia's battle with Drel comes to a conclusion as Clevatess questions what he's done.

info.title: Leviathan
info.synopsis: In un passato steampunk alternativo, un principe austriaco in fuga e un aviatore scozzese in incognito intraprendono un'insolita missione per evitare una guerra mondiale.

episodes.title: Into the Storm
episodes.synopsis: 1914. Prince Alek of Austria-Hungary goes on an unusual practice session in a Stormwalker. In Edinburgh, Sharp eagerly takes flight in a Huxley.

episodes.title: Prelude to War
episodes.synopsis: As Europe teeters on the edge of an all-out war, Alek struggles with his new life in hiding. Sharp gets acquainted with the Leviathan and its crew.

episodes.title: Clankers and Darwinists
episodes.synopsis: Alek learns why he's hunted and, despite Volger's advice, sneaks out to aid the Leviathan's crew. He saves Sharp, who doesn't buy the prince's story.

episodes.title: The Weight of the Past
episodes.synopsis: With Clanker forces hot on their tail, the wounded Leviathan needs a miracle to get off the ground. Alek makes an offer the Darwinists can't refuse.

episodes.title: Far to the East
episodes.synopsis: The Leviathan encounters a deadly Clanker weapon on its journey towards Istanbul. Upon arriving in the city, Alek and his comrades make plans to escape.

episodes.title: Shadows of Istanbul
episodes.synopsis: Sharp and Dr. Barlow finally meet the Sultan, hoping to smooth things over with a rare gift. Meanwhile, a mysterious girl saves Alek from a German patrol.

episodes.title: Stormy Seas
episodes.synopsis: A patrol jeopardizes the British secret operation, forcing Sharp to flee into Istanbul's streets. Alek commits himself to the revolutionary army's cause.

episodes.title: Behemoth
episodes.synopsis: On the day of the coup, Alek urges Klopp to leave for his safety. Later, unexpected news forces the revolutionaries to act before the Behemoth arrives.

episodes.title: Tunguska
episodes.synopsis: The Leviathan and its crew arrive in Siberia to meet Barlow's uncle. He reveals the source behind numerous mysterious phenomena around the world.

episodes.title: Truth and Lies
episodes.synopsis: Tensions run high after Alek learns the truth about his friend. But before they can talk things over, Sharp gets into a dangerous predicament.

episodes.title: Goliath
episodes.synopsis: Determined to uncover the truth about Tunguska, Alek and Sharp confront Tesla and learn about the invention responsible for the destruction: the Goliath.

episodes.title: Under the Same Sky
episodes.synopsis: Tesla issues a deadly ultimatum as a last resort. Can Sharp and Alek, stuck on opposing sides, prevent the conflict from escalating before it's too late?

info.title: The Diary of a Crazed Family
info.synopsis: Circa 1.000 anni fa, una creatura molto potente chiamata Enka riuscì quasi a distruggere il mondo. I sopravvissuti si unirono contro Enka, riuscendo a sconfiggerlo. Tuttavia, Enka ha lasciato dietro di sé una maledizione minacciosa prima della sua morte: "Mio figlio, dormendo dove nessuno lo sa, si sveglierà 1.000 anni dopo, e riuscirà la mia volontà a distruggere il mondo." Nel 2063, diversi bambini che sono potenziali eredi di Enka vengono scoperti tramite test del DNA. Tuttavia, anche con la più recente tecnologia, nessuno può identificare con certezza il vero bambino. Pertanto, l'Agenzia imperiale giapponese, che gestisce fenomeni soprannaturali, lancia l'Operation: Peaceful Family ossia raccogliere i potenziali figli di Enka in un posto per vegliare su di loro e trovare il vero bambino. Si spera anche che il vero bambino svilupperà un amore per la famiglia con cui vive, e quindi si sentirà contrario a distruggendo il mondo. La persona che interpreta il ruolo del padre è Midarezaki Ouka dove lavora per l'agenzia ed è stato scelto per essere il padre prima che ne venisse a conoscenza. La madre è Kyouka, un possibile figlio di Enka. Dato che ci sono altri cinque possibili bambini di Enka, inizia così una vita familiare molto strana.

episodes.title: Kyouka-sama, Reign!
episodes.synopsis: Ouka stumbles upon a "young girl" stealing an apple one day, per chance, to find himself part of the "Cozy Family Operation" - a top secret mission, in which he has to take the place of father for an abnormal family, in order to find the child of Enka, who is destined to destroy the world.

episodes.title: The Party Never Ends
episodes.synopsis: While Kyouka is busy dreaming about the perfect wedding for her and Ouka, Yuuka is having a hard time fitting into school. In order to resolve the problem, Kyouka jumps into a mother's shoes, and so, in the middle of Yuuka's gym lesson, the frenzied family perform a short play, and successfully make Yuuka appear like a magical girl. Meanwhile the culprit behind the bullying is revealed.

episodes.title: The Oni Princess of the Himemiya
episodes.synopsis: The bullying is yet to cease, and so, Yuuka comes home crying one day, to be comforted by Ginka. The family express their concerns, especially after it appears Teika and Hyouka are ready to do some serious about the situation. The next day, Yuuka is confronted by a teenage girl - her biological sister, Senko, who has come to take her younger sister back. The truth regarding Yuuka's previous family is revealed - her family traditionally tortures the youngest daughter - Yuuka - for being a demon. Before the situation gets out of hand, Ginka appears, and apparently knows Senko. Night comes, and the bullies are at it again, this time aided by Senko, who is madder than ever before, claiming she needs to be saved too. Ginka's second arrival spurs this, as Senko wakes up in the Midarezaki household. Kyouka threatens to kill Senko for being an enemy of the family, but Ouka jumps in and pulls her away. After the family turn up at the Himemiya mansion, Senko offically becomes a new addition to the family - Chika Midarezaki.

episodes.title: Make Sure You Plan Ahead Whether It Be a Trip or a Curse
episodes.synopsis: Kyouka discovers that married couples go on honeymoons prior to their marriage, and so, begins to book one, with help from Chika, who sees it as an opportunity for her and Ginka to get together.

episodes.title: Survival Honeymoon
episodes.synopsis: Kyouka builts an airport outside of the Midarezaki family household, so the family can head off to the honeymoon without too much fuss. The family become good friends with a boy nicknamed "Pierre", however, their hotel resort is dangerous, and thus, Yuuka is kidnapped by a group of evil monkeys.

episodes.title: Frenzied Professor and the Party`s Second Act
episodes.synopsis: The family, in an attempt to save Yuuka, entice the monkeys of the island with free food and a huge party, while Yuuka becomes friends with the mad doctor of the island, who later turns out to be one of Hyouka's many creators.

episodes.title: Xiexie! Chinese Assassination!
episodes.synopsis: Shu and Tsubaki were born in a family of assassins, however, Shu desperately wants to be a chef. The problem is, his food kills who ever eats it. Fortunately, Yuuka, Tsubaki's classmate, and the rest of her wacky family, are determined to get to the bottom of why the food kills everyone, and make sure that Shu's restaurant lives another day.

episodes.title: Making A Kind Shinigami
episodes.synopsis: Ouka is on a date with an old friend of his - a Death God who mercilessly tried to kill him while they were children. Their date is briefly interrupted by Kyouka, and later the rest of the family, while all the cameras that surround them become possessed by a bunny-eared girl called "Ei".

episodes.title: The God`s and Shinigami`s Party
episodes.synopsis: Kyouka's past is briefly explained in this episode, as Ei brutally tries to kill her and Ouka. At the end of the episode, Ouka is stabbed by the possessed Death God, who reveals an ugly bruise on her eye. At the end of the episode, all is well, however, Ei is somewhere, seeking revenge.

episodes.title: Innocent Pirate Mujyakey
episodes.synopsis: Mujaki is a kind pirate, who's deceased father left her a treasure map. Kyouka wants the treasure, however ends up getting kidnapped. The family head out to sea to save Kyouka, but end up getting washed up in a cave, where the treasure is held.

episodes.title: Hyouka`s First Love
episodes.synopsis: Hyouka meets a girl he called "Musume-san", and the two strike up an unusual friendship. Ginka claims that this must be Hyouka's first love. However, the relationship is threatened, when everyone discovers that Musume-san's sister was killed by Hyouka, against his will.

episodes.title: Picked up Cat on Monday
episodes.synopsis: Prior to the beginning of the story, Ginka's next door neighbour picks up a cat, to find that it has turned into a young girl by morning. The episode details their love story, with Ginka as a side character, dressed entirely as a woman through the course of the episode.

episodes.title: The Melancholy of Chika
episodes.synopsis:
Chika goes to school, however a bunch of classmates ask her help to solve the disappearances of several classmates. Kyouka appears to help and they discover that the reason behind the disappearances was a drug developed by the mafia that turned people into animals.
In the end they are saved by a green version of Hyouka and confront the true mastermind of the plan, a experience created by the department of supernatural affairs known as Electric butterfly.

episodes.title: Electric-Butterfly
episodes.synopsis: The Electric butterfly having planned the catastrophe turning humans into animals, releases Dr. Gebock in order to test the Miderazeki family's potential as a weapon. Hyouka utilizes the Lucifer Cannon to save his family. Chika gets the credit for saving everyone at school.

episodes.title: My Wife Is A Witch
episodes.synopsis: Kyouka clumsily tries to use a magic wand from the Electric Butterfly and punish Ouka for forgetting that it is their anniversary. The wand attacks whoever the person is thinking about with a severity equal to their love however Kyoka ends up zapping everyone but Ouka and in the end she destroys the wand after it tryed to kill Ouka.

episodes.title: Red and White Madara
episodes.synopsis: Teika tries to teach a fellow lion that not all humans are evil. Dr. Gebock is back and is now drinking buddies with Ginka at Virgo.

episodes.title: The Battle Is "A Melonpan, Please"
episodes.synopsis: Teika sacrifices himself to save the female lion madara from the hunter. Gekka heals him. The humans and lions negotiate a peace to live alongside the wild animals without hunting each other.

episodes.title: Proper Nursing Method
episodes.synopsis: When Ouka becomes sick the house falls into chaos without his reason and guidance, so the family track down a mask that might heal Ouka but in the end curses him, so they are forced to shrink and fight his disease from inside his body.

episodes.title: Even If You Don`t Want To Be, You`re the Clumsy Devil
episodes.synopsis: A bumbling demon tries to kill the family with a bomb but she has second thoughts when she observes the love the family has. Hyouka must face his feelings for Musume-san once again as she works at the hot spring and sauna. Chika and Ginka engage in S&M in Chika's ongoing quest to turn Ginka heterosexual.

episodes.title: Forest of Vitamin C
episodes.synopsis: When Chika gets bitten by a hamster she has flashbacks to memories of her first pet, a gigantic demonic monster which is actually just a cursed man. Although Chika tried to use him against the House of Oni he refused. When soldiers attack Chika searching for this monster she finds out there are connections between her first pet and her new best friend Hijiri.

episodes.title: Black Santa-chan Doesn`t Sleep at Night
episodes.synopsis: When Santa Clause's granddaughter becomes depressed that grandpa never spends Christmas with her Kyouka makes the family deliver presents and take over Santa's duties while she beats Saint Nick into submission to convince him he needs to think of his own family as well as others.

episodes.title: Falling Princess
episodes.synopsis: Electric Butterfly warns the family of an Alien who looks weak but could destroy the world. When a female alien named Oasis comes to earth in search of the meaning of the word Love. The family members try to show her so she will leave but coincidences make everyone think Ouka is having an affair with her.

episodes.title: The Name Is Gouyokuou!
episodes.synopsis: Oasis was not who Electric Butterfly was reffering to when she talked of a weak looking alien who could destroy the world. So when an alien invasion kicks off and a bumbling lovestruck alien of immense power comes to earth after a millenia of waiting... for Gekka's hand in marraige. Gekka is preoccupied with something else.

episodes.title: Object X From Space
episodes.synopsis: Oasis is revealed to be of a species spawned by Gekka thousands of years ago. Meanwhile Gekka must stop her offspring who want to rebel against her for abandoning them with only the lonely alien as their God. The family meets a worshipper of Kyouka who is unbeknowst to them possessed by a child of Gekka. Chika and Yuuka's big sister is revealed to be Electric Butterfly's boss and declares war on the all powerful bumbling alien.

episodes.title: Kyouka-sama, Frenzy!
episodes.synopsis: Since the children of Gekka would die without Gekka they seek to punish her by destroying the family and earth she loves. The family must also stop her bumbling alien from destroying the earth as he is attacked. An evil waterspirit spawn of gekka possesses Kyouka.

episodes.title: Once Again, the Legend of Enka!
episodes.synopsis: The family debates who Enka was referring to in her prophecy, and ends up closer then ever. Realizing they are a real family by birth or not.

info.title: The Summer Hikaru Died (ITA)
info.synopsis: Yoshiki e Hikaru sono due ragazzi coetanei cresciuti insieme in un piccolo villaggio. Un giorno, Yoshiki nota la presenza di qualcosa di diverso nel suo amico: una qualche entità ha preso il suo posto. Pur sapendolo, Yoshiki continua a essergli amico, ma nel frattempo nel villaggio iniziano a verificarsi strani incidenti...

episodes.title: Replacement
episodes.synopsis: Yoshiki confronts Hikaru about his suspicions and discovers the terrifying truth. Even though they try to live normally, eerie incidents begin to occur.

episodes.title: Suspicion
episodes.synopsis: While Yoshiki and Hikaru accompany their classmates to a creepy mountain trail, a mysterious man arrives at Kubitachi Village and begins investigating.

episodes.title: Denial
episodes.synopsis: Recalling childhood memories with Hikaru, Yoshiki continues to struggle with his complex emotions. Desperate, he reaches out to Kurebayashi.

episodes.title: Summer Festival
episodes.synopsis: As Yoshiki attends the summer festival with Hikaru, the village elders fret over the recent death and Tanaka ends up with more questions than answers.

episodes.title: Wig Ghost
episodes.synopsis: When Yoshiki's sister spots a creepy clump of hair in the bathroom, Hikaru visits the Tsujinaka home to investigate — but things take a deadly turn.

episodes.title: Asako
episodes.synopsis: Yoshiki and his classmates discuss a story their teacher assigned them. Later, at a sleepover, Asako's sharp observations put her in grave danger.

episodes.title: Determination
episodes.synopsis: After the sobering realization that Hikaru is truly dangerous, Yoshiki decides that he must act and invites his best friend to skip school together.

episodes.title: Contact
episodes.synopsis: Yoshiki and Hikaru investigate Nonuki-sama and its link to Kubitachi's history. While at the library, they get an important lead from a surprising source.

episodes.title: Old Man Takeda
episodes.synopsis: Kurebayashi shares her knowledge about impurities with the boys. Later, the elder Takeda loses his temper over Hikaru's ignorance of the Indo's history.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.synopsis: The boys' surprise encounter with Tanaka lands them in the hospital. When they return to school, Yoshiki pieces together the truth behind Nonuki-sama.

episodes.title: Indo`s Sin
episodes.synopsis: Though hesitant, Yoshiki asks his father about the Indo family's murky past and secret ritual. Later, Hikaru loses control at school and feels deeply shaken.

episodes.title: Its Place
episodes.synopsis: While everyone else attends the school assembly, Asako finds Hikaru wandering the halls. Alone at the beach, Hikaru reveals his final plans to Yoshiki.

info.title: Hikuidori: Ushuu Boro Tobi-gumi
info.synopsis: Matsunaga Gengo, un tempo conosciuto come “l’Uccello divorafiamme”, era il miglior samurai pompiere di Edo. Dopo aver lasciato la brigata per motivi personali, riceve un invito a servire il clan Shinjo. Tuttavia, la squadra antincendio del clan è povera, senza uomini e derisa dagli altri. Spronato dalla moglie Miyuki, Gengo decide di ricostruire il corpo in rovina e ne diventa il capo. Insieme a compagni eccentrici, affronta con coraggio l’obiettivo di “salvare ogni vita”, anche se vengono disprezzati come i “Boro-Tobi-Gumi” (gli “scalcinati steeplejacks”). Nel frattempo, a Edo si diffonde una serie di misteriosi incendi sospetti, noti come i “fuochi delle volpi”.

info.title: I Want to End this Love Game
info.synopsis: Yukiya Asagi e Miku Sakura sono amici d'infanzia che sono sempre stati legati sin da quando erano piccoli. Quando erano alle elementari, i due hanno creato un gioco con l'obbiettivo di mettere in imbarazzo l'altro dicendogli "ti amo", e quattro anni dopo, al loro primo anno delle superiori, ancora cercano di ottenere la vittoria sull'altro. Tuttavia, quando in entrambi iniziano a realizzare di provare sentimenti per l'altro, la frase inizia a prendere un nuovo significato che va oltre quello del loro semplice gioco. Sia Yukiya e Miku vorrebbero essere sinceri con l'altro, ma il timore di cosa possa succedere tra di loro dopo che il gioco si sarà concluso li rende esitanti a fare la prima mossa.

episodes.title: My Childhood Friend Refuses to Accept Defeat
episodes.synopsis: Yukiya and Miku are trapped in a game of their own making. The struggle continues until either admits defeat.

episodes.title: My Childhood Friend Cooks
episodes.synopsis: Yukiya and Miku each have their own agendas in making lunch.

episodes.title: Childhood Friend Seduction
episodes.synopsis: Yukiya comes up with a grand plan for a date.

episodes.title: My Childhood Friend Will Do Anything
episodes.synopsis: Miku and Yukiya realize the consequences of "anything goes" in the love game.

episodes.title: My Childhood Friend Comes in the Morning
episodes.synopsis: Yukiya argues with his little sister, and Miku suggests they go out shopping.

episodes.title: My Childhood Friend Wants to Sleep Over
episodes.synopsis: Miku is worried that Yukiya isn't attracted to her. She and Wakana come up with a plan.

episodes.title: My Childhood Friend Wants to Win
episodes.synopsis: Miku is going to spend the night at Yukiya's house, and both find their emotions overflowing.

episodes.title: My Childhood Friend and the Student Council President
episodes.synopsis: The Student Council President catches Yukiya and Miku up to their usual antics and calls them in for a talk.

episodes.title: My Childhood Friend Becomes My Apprentice?
episodes.synopsis: Miku helps Shirayuri win over her childhood friend while figuring out how to move things forward with Yukiya.

episodes.title: My Childhood Friend Is Unstoppable
episodes.synopsis: Miku’s proposed game with Yukiya spirals out of control as hidden feelings come to light.

episodes.title: My Childhood Friend Embraces Me
episodes.synopsis: Miku challenges Yukiya to the Pocky Game.

episodes.title: My Childhood Friend Is Girly
episodes.synopsis: Natsuki suggests making snacks with Yukiya to thank him for taking care of her when she was sick.

info.title: Wandance (ITA)
info.synopsis: Kaboku Kotani sta per iniziare il liceo e ha intenzione di continuare con la sua solita vita: andare d'accordo con i suoi amici, starsene in silenzio e non attirare troppo l'attenzione su di sé. In fin dei conti è già abbastanza difficile cavarsela con una balbuzie come la sua, perché dovrebbe peggiorare le cose distinguendosi dalla massa? Ma poi vede un'altra matricola, Hikari Wanda, che balla come se nessuno la stesse guardando... o per essere precisi, a lei non sembra importare del giudizio delle persone. Kaboku, colpito dall'atteggiamento della ragazza, inizia a chiedersi come potrebbe raggiungere la stessa libertà. Per trovare risposta a questo suo dubbio fa una cosa impensabile per lui: iscriversi al club di ballo. Dopotutto ogni cambiamento inizia con un piccolo passo, giusto? Unisciti a Kaboku e Wanda mentre si fanno strada verso la vita e l'amore!

episodes.title: Wanda`s Dance
episodes.synopsis: Kabo, a high school freshman struggling with a stutter, meets Wanda, who dances alone without concern for others. Feeling stifled by what other people think of him, Kabo is captivated by Wanda's free-spirited moves. He begins to take an interest in dance as a form of self-expression.

episodes.title: Dance Club Gender Ratio
episodes.synopsis: During a trial session with the dance club, Kabo learns the basic moves and the importance of truly listening to the music from the club president, On. Though awkward at first, Kabo gradually settles into the club and begins practicing one-on-one with Wanda after school.

episodes.title: Audition
episodes.synopsis: To prepare for a high school dance contest in June, the dance club holds a freestyle audition. Drawn in by Wanda's dancing, Kabo begins to grasp how to let his body be moved by the music. On the way home, he learns about On's hopes for this year's contest.

episodes.title: Choreography Routine
episodes.synopsis: Kabo, Wanda, and Aoi are chosen to take part in the contest. Meanwhile, Yura, who was not selected, struggles to accept the decision. Kabo happens to run into another male club member Iori, who performed in last year's contest.

episodes.title: Feeling
episodes.synopsis: During a battle, Kabo is overwhelmed when he sees Ioris dancing house for the first time. He begins to see the connection between the times he speaks without stuttering and the times he dances and begins to consider a career as a dancer.

episodes.title: Contest
episodes.synopsis: At last, the day of the dance contest arrives for Ichirin High School. With all the unique rival schools gathered, the tension at the venue peaks. Encouraged by Iori and Wanda, Kabo steps onto the stage. Everything hangs on whether the dancers can bring passion to their performance.

episodes.title: Wanda`s Pre-High School Days
episodes.synopsis: The results of the high school dance contest are out. Though they are dancing together, Kabo feels distance from Wanda, and recalls how she used to dance alone when they first met. Before entering high school, Wanda worked part-time at a convenience store while practicing dance entirely on her own.

episodes.title: Dance Battle
episodes.synopsis: Right after the contest, On and Iori face off in a dance battle. Kabo and Wanda are both in awe of how the pair challenges each other's technique and style as they reach new heights. After the club members judge, Iori selects Kabo as On's next battle opponent.

episodes.title: The Style Wall
episodes.synopsis: Kabo starts training with Iori during lunch and begins to discover the thrill of dance battles. Iori mentions a skilled dancer called Gaku Kabeya, or Kabe, who specializes in breakdancing. Iori invites Kabo and Wanda to join the B-BOY's practice at the park, where Kabe is also training.

episodes.title: Prelims
episodes.synopsis: The solo division of the Inter-High Dance Battle begins, and On, Iori, and Wanda advance smoothly through the prelims. Shaken by Wanda's absence and the unfamiliar environment, Kabo messes up his timing. Confused, he finishes the prelims without showing his true strengths.

episodes.title: Self-Awareness
episodes.synopsis: In the second match of round one in the Inter-High Dance Battle, On faces Usen Takumi, a dancer with a unique style. Kabo is moved by the fierce performances of On and Wanda, unlike anything he has seen in practice. But Kabe thinks battles are meaningless unless you win.

episodes.title: Wandance
episodes.synopsis: Kabo faces Kabe in the semifinals. Taking the first turn, Kabe blindfolds himself with a mask, and finishes the first song as if to say Kabo's dance is not even worth watching. Confronting Kabe's raw emotion head-on, Kabo's own feelings begin to break free.

info.title: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers
info.synopsis: Ito Narita è una liceale abituata a vivere come figlia unica, ma la sua vita cambia quando la madre si risposa. Trasferendosi nella nuova casa, scopre di avere quattro fratellastri, tutti diversi tra loro e inizialmente difficili da comprendere. La convivenza è complicata: Ito fatica ad adattarsi e i ragazzi reagiscono in modi contrastanti alla sua presenza. Con il tempo però, attraverso piccoli gesti e momenti condivisi, i rapporti si ammorbidiscono. Ito impara a conoscere le loro fragilità e loro iniziano ad accettarla come parte della famiglia. La storia segue così il percorso di crescita della protagonista, tra affetti nascenti, situazioni quotidiane caotiche e la lenta costruzione di un nuovo equilibrio familiare.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Narita Family
episodes.synopsis: Only-child Ito’s life changes overnight when her mom remarries—and she gains four new stepbrothers!

episodes.title: Lies Make Families
episodes.synopsis: Ito suggest Mom goes with Dad since they just got married. But Gen tells Ito to go as well and not come back?!

episodes.title: The Narita Family`s New Rule
episodes.synopsis: Ito's midterm scores are terrible, so Raku helps her study in secret because Gen can't find out!

episodes.title: Unable to Be Honest
episodes.synopsis: Gomez has run away, and during the search Gen gets hurt. Even then, he won't allow Ito to take care of him.

episodes.title: Shut Away Angel
episodes.synopsis: The whole family is together for a BBQ -- except the shut in, Shu. Can Ito finally get through to him?

episodes.title: Sibling`s Feelings
episodes.synopsis: Ito and Shu's party is facing their fiercest opponent yet. Can they overcome this challenge and break free?

episodes.title: My Younger Brother Is a Prince?
episodes.synopsis: It's summer, so the family goes to see Ito's friends. Back in school, Gen is forced to be a prince for a play?

episodes.title: What`ll Happen to the Cultural Festival?!
episodes.synopsis: Ito feels some way about Gen, but she’s not sure what exactly. Udagawa sees right through her and says it's...

episodes.title: The Birthday Present Bonus
episodes.synopsis: Ito realizes she has romantic feelings for Gen. Raku finds out, and Gen overhears them talking about it.

episodes.title: A Sign of Connection
episodes.synopsis: Shu has a cosplayer friend?! Shu wants to meet this friend at an IRL event, but can he muster the courage?

episodes.title: The Hiroshima Onomichi Steam Incident
episodes.synopsis: Ito and Gen end up sightseeing alone on the school trip, and then something unexpected occurs…?!

episodes.title: Let the Memories Fall
episodes.synopsis: It's Christmas and everyone is home! After a huge party, Ito learns this day is very special for the Naritas.

episodes.title: Into the New Year! Valentines!
episodes.synopsis: As Raku's out shopping on NYE, a woman asks to borrow his phone. Then she asks Raku for a favor...

episodes.title: This Love Can`t Be Suppressed
episodes.synopsis: Since Valentine's, Ito wavers between just confessing her love to Gen, and protecting the order of the family.

episodes.title: How I Really Feel
episodes.synopsis: Since hearing how Gen feels, Ito is completely distracted and falls down the stairs...

episodes.title: The Troubled Narita Brothers
episodes.synopsis: Being rejected has torn a hole in Ito's heart. Gen also doesn't know how to act. What can be done to fix it?
